Swiss Interior Design
Advertiser: Swiss Interior
Started: 25 Mar 2026
In a modern luxe home, lighting is not just functional. It is
part of the overall design. Notice how the warm glow behind
the wardrobe’s reeded glass panels creates a soft, diffused
light that feels like a luxury boutique hotel. In the dining
area, the sculptural chandelier does more than light up the
table. It becomes the visual centre of the room. Lighting is
thoughtfully layered through ambient, accent and task sources
so the home feels elegant and well balanced at any time of
day. At Swiss Interior, lighting design is never an
afterthought. It is one of the most important ways we bring a
modern luxe space to life. The difference is something you
feel the moment you step into the home. If you are planning to
renovate your home, check out Swiss Interior and discover how
thoughtful lighting design can transform the way your space
looks and feels. ✨ In a modern luxe home, lighting is not just
